Within 90 days of this approval and as requested thereafter, the Census Bureau and the National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics must brief OMB on the implementation of the Annual Business Survey collected in 2026 and provide an overview of any planned, proposed revisions to the Annual Business Survey collected in 2027. | |
